title: GROB: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Public-Trace Investigation of Candidate Agentic Activity
abstract: arXiv:2610.11467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present GROB, a multi-agent architecture for investigating candidate autonomous-agent activity through public Internet traces when privileged telemetry is unavailable. The system performs controlled, read-only collection of public traces and preserves selected observations for later resolution. In a frozen September 2026 corpus, several collected traces became more informative as additional public evidence emerged. The strongest result concerns Census-labelled identifiers captured on 9 September. Public revision records later resolved these identifiers to specific Census requests from 16 - 17 June. Other results show weaker links between traces collected by GROB and evidence reconstructed or reported later. These links vary in strength, and only some can be tied to specific public records. The results show that sparse public traces can remain useful even before their significance is fully understood. Such evidence can support later

translated_title: GROB：一种用于候选智能体活动公开痕迹调查的多智能体架构
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GROB，一种在无法获取特权遥测数据时，通过公开互联网痕迹调查候选自主智能体活动的多智能体架构。该系统对公开痕迹进行受控的只读收集，并保存选定的观测结果以供后续解析。在2026年9月的冻结语料库中，随着更多公开证据的出现，若干收集到的痕迹变得更具信息价值。最强的结果涉及9月9日捕获的带有“人口普查”标签的标识符：公开的修订记录随后将这些标识符解析为6月16日至17日发出的特定人口普查请求。其他结果显示GROB收集的痕迹与后来重建或报告的证据之间存在较弱的联系。这些联系强度不一，且只有部分能够与特定的公开记录相关联。结果表明，稀疏的公开痕迹即使在其重要性尚未被完全理解时仍可保持有用性。此类证据能够支持后续……
tldr: GROB是一种在缺乏特权遥测时通过受控只读方式收集公开互联网痕迹来调查候选自主智能体活动的多智能体架构，其证明稀疏的公开痕迹可在后续新公开证据（如将人口普查标识符解析为特定请求）出现后获得重要价值。
en_tdlr: GROB is a multi-agent architecture that investigates candidate autonomous-agent activity through controlled, read-only collection of public Internet traces when privileged telemetry is unavailable, demonstrating that sparse public traces can gain significance later as additional public evidence, such as resolving Census-labelled identifiers to specific requests, emerges.
